# Feature: account-screen
## Purpose
Show an account.
## User outcome
People understand their account at a glance.
## Scope and non-goals
Account display only.
## Positive flow
Open the screen and see the account.
## Negative and recovery flow
Unavailable data produces a clear retry path.
## User inputs and visible outcomes
The person opens the screen and sees account information.
## Done outcomes
### DC-01 Account appears
Given an account, when opened, then its details appear.
## Subjective user-test questions
Is the account easy to understand?
## Applicable principles
(none identified)
